roster.intro: One list, read by several parts of the platform: drills and certification tracking in Safety, the three directors named on your permit forms, and lifeguard cover in Pool Manager. Change someone once and they change everywhere.
roster.empty: No active staff yet. Add the people who work at your camp and their certifications.
roster.formsWant: The forms still want {{gaps}} from this record.
roster.privateNote: Dates of birth and the other details the permit forms ask about a person are kept for camp admins only, so they are not shown here.

completeness.heading: The permit forms are waiting on some of this roster.
completeness.missingDob_one: {{count}} of the {{total}} certified staff has no date of birth on file. DOH-367a prints one beside every certification, so that cell will come out blank.
completeness.missingDob_other: {{count}} of the {{total}} certified staff have no date of birth on file. DOH-367a prints one beside every certification, so those cells will come out blank.
completeness.directorAsks_one: DOH-367 asks your {{role}} for {{needs}}. {{name}} has none on file.
completeness.directorAsks_other: DOH-367 asks your {{role}} for {{needs}}. {{name}} has neither on file.

intake.title: Let staff fill in their own details
intake.body: Send one link to everybody. They give their date of birth, education and camp experience — the fields the state’s permit forms ask about a person and no roster export carries. Replies wait here for you to apply.
intake.expires: Expires {{date}}. Revoking it stops the link at once; anything already submitted stays in your queue.
intake.expiresNever: This link does not expire. Revoking it stops the link at once; anything already submitted stays in your queue.

form.intro: Staff members added here can be tracked for certifications and training compliance.
form.confirmDelete: Remove {{name}} from staff? This will delete all their certifications.
form.name: Full name *
form.title: Title / role *
form.permitHeading: Details the permit forms ask for
form.permitHint: Optional. Leave blank and the form prints a blank line for someone to write on.
form.everyCertified: Asked about every certified staff member
form.dobHelp: DOH-367a prints this beside every lifeguard and first aid certification. It is personal information about an employee, and anyone with access to this camp can see it.
form.sexHelp: The counselor table on DOH-367a counts staff as male or female. Those are the only two columns the state prints.
form.directorsOnly: Asked only about the camp, health and aquatics directors
form.educationPlaceholder: e.g. BS Recreation Management, SUNY Cortland 2014
form.experiencePlaceholder: e.g. Six seasons as unit head at a NYS children's camp
form.licenseHelp: DOH-367 asks the health director for a NYS license number.

import.doneNote: Certifications and screening dates are not part of an import. Add those from the staff clearance screen, where each one is recorded by a person who knows what they are attesting to.
import.title: Import a staff roster
import.intro: Export your roster from CampMinder, CampBrain, or whatever holds it, and paste it below. A spreadsheet copied straight out of Excel works too. Nothing is saved until you confirm the columns.
import.headersNote: Keep the column headings in English — they are how each column is recognised.
import.ignoring: Ignoring {{headers}}. We record that a check was run and when — never its result, and never a social security number.
import.dobNotUnderstood: date of birth not understood, left blank

labels.title: Print QR labels
labels.noLocations: No locations yet. Add them in Camp Info first.
labels.reprintHint: Prints only the one below — into whichever slot is still free on a part-used sheet.
labels.reissueTitle: Issue a new code for this label
labels.tickToPreview: Tick a location or an asset to see its label.
labels.rotateError: Could not reissue that code. Only a camp administrator can.
labels.printTipAvery: Load Avery 5163 label stock, then in the print dialog set scale to 100% (not “fit to page”) and turn headers and footers off. Either one shifts the whole grid off its backing.
labels.printTipLetter: Load plain US Letter, then in the print dialog set scale to 100% (not “fit to page”) and turn headers and footers off. Either one shifts the whole grid off its backing.
labels.confirmBody: Every sticker already printed for this one stops working the moment you do. Somebody standing in front of it will get “this code is not recognised”, so only do this if the old code is being abused — and reprint and replace the sticker today.
